Name: Achievement Replacement
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Achievement Replacement [/b][/size]
[i]Tired of seeing the same golden star every time you unlock an achievement?[/i][/center]
[center]This mod replaces the game's native achievement notifications with the original, high-resolution Steam icons, wrapped in a clean, customizable UI label.[/center]
[line]
[size=5][b]✨ Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
Authentic Steam Icons: Displays the real Steam icon for all 39 in-game achievements.Custom UI Label: Features a sleek notification box with soft outlines and highly readable text.Full GMCM Integration: Customize everything in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu.Color System: Choose from 9 different background colors for your notification (Original White, Red, Navy Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Pink, Cyan, and Purple).Total Control: Adjust the position (X/Y), icon size, and notification spacing in real-time.Anti-duplication System: Prevents the vanilla golden star from appearing alongside your custom notification.[/list][line]
[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/size]
Once installed, you can tweak the mod in-game by going to [b]Options -> Mod Options -> Achievement Replacement[/b]:
[list]
Toggle Mod: Enable or disable the mod completely.Suppress Vanilla: Hide the original game notification to avoid duplicates.Position X / Y: Move the notification anywhere on your screen.Icon Size: Scale the icons up or down (16px to 64px).Spacing: Adjust the distance between stacked notifications.Label Color: Pick your favorite background color![/list][line]
[size=5][b]📋 Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher.Generic Mod Config Menu (Highly recommended for customization).[/list][line]
[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
Install SMAPI.Install Generic Mod Config Menu.Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy![/list][line]
[center][i]If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please let me know in the Posts tab! Happy farming! 🚜✨[/i][/center]
